purpose: Links ticket-only gasha pools to the client's own gasha art (RAW image_gasha_banner_/logo_/bg_<gasha id>). GashaData, which named each gasha's LogoResourceId and TopResourceId, was server-delivered and is not archived, so each link is read from the pool name drawn on the banner. The banner_text values are transcriptions of that drawn text.

basis.banner_text: The banner draws this pool's exact name, and no other banner draws it.
basis.banner_text_chronology: Several banners draw the same name; regular pools 1xxxx are numbered in opening order (all 49 announcement-linked codes 10003-10055 confirm it), and this id falls between the anchors around the wiki run.
basis.banner_text_shared: Several banners draw this name and the pool ran more than once; the banners are kept as same-name variants without assigning each to a run.
